summary: Re-verified the search count fix after the retry-and-cache patch. Backend cold-start (backend restarted before test) returned correct totals for every query: roth=53, medicare=20, all=196, retirement+category=58, nonsense=0. Second call is served from cache in ~0.2s. Frontend: 'Showing 20 of 53 for roth' renders correctly on first search, result cards now show the post date ('Mar 26, 2026 · Watch'), Load More reads 'Load 20 more', updates to 'Load 13 more', and disappears with 'END OF RESULTS · 53 SHOWN' after reaching 53. Empty-state renders correctly for a no-match query. 9/9 pytest tests pass sequentially. One caveat: under pytest-xdist parallel workers hammering WP in parallel, WP rate-limits enough 429s in a row to exhaust the 3-attempt backoff and the endpoint can return 0 — not a real user-facing scenario, but worth noting.

minor.issue: Under highly concurrent load (e.g., pytest-xdist with 2 workers hammering WP simultaneously), 3 consecutive 429s can exhaust the retry loop and the endpoint returns 0. Not a real end-user scenario (users make sequential requests), but if desired: bump attempts to 4 or add jittered backoff. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:637-663

action_items: No blocking issues. Fix is verified end-to-end. Optional: to make count endpoint even more resilient under bursty load, extend the 3-attempt retry to 4 attempts with jittered backoff — but current behavior meets the review spec on cold-start.
critical_code_review_comments: _wp_get_total() cleanly separates the WP total lookup with retry + short-TTL cache (120s non-zero, 30s zero). Reads well.
Frontend belt-and-suspenders retry after 1.5s (search.tsx:51-55) is a nice safety net; correctly guarded by requestSeq to avoid stale-response race.
Consider adding a testID to the count Text node (search.tsx:203) so future tests can select it deterministically instead of relying on regex text match.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix is complete and verified. If touched again, cold-start verification is: `sudo supervisorctl restart backend && sleep 4 && curl $EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/api/wp/posts/count?search=roth` — must return {"total":53} first hit. Frontend regression check: /search → type 'roth' → 'Showing 20 of 53 for roth', Load More label 'Load 20 more', cards show a date. Pytest: `pytest backend/tests/test_iteration11_search_count.py -v -o addopts=''` (disable xdist to avoid concurrent WP rate-limit noise).
rca_of_issue: Root cause from iteration 11: the count endpoint used raw httpx with no retry/cache while wp_get had retry+cache. On WP cold-start 429s, count returned 0 and the UI fell back to the pre-fix label. Fix in iteration 12: new _wp_get_total() helper with 3-attempt retry (0.8s + 1.6s backoff) covering both 429/503 and 200-with-X-WP-Total=0 hiccup cases, plus 120s cache for successful non-zero totals (30s for zero). Frontend added an additional client-side 1.5s retry as belt-and-suspenders and now renders the post date on each result card. Verified: cold-start returns correct total on the first request across all 5 queries in the review; UI matches the exact expected copy.
